faq.question: Where do hotel review cards usually work best?
faq.answer: They usually work best at checkout, concierge or other service moments where staff already interacts with guests and can naturally invite a review.

faq.question: Should hotels use the same review prompt format everywhere?
faq.answer: Not always. Some hotels do better with a desk-delivered card, while others benefit more from a static QR or sticker prompt in a specific guest area.
